     Benzoate of Ammonium. C7H5O(NH4)O.

     Proved by Wibmer ; also proved and used by Jeanes.

   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Am. be.]
Feeling of swelling and soreness, apparently in puncta and saccus lachrymalis.
Eyelids swollen. θ Albuminuria.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Am. be.]
Face bloated. θ Albuminuria.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Am. be.]
Swelling under tongue, right side, like ranula.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Am. be.]
Eructation of food without acidity, with apparent weakness of digestion, or acid eructations.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Am. be.]
Increased warmth in stomach.
Slight discomfort in stomach.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Am. be.]
Sensation of soreness between abdominal rings, in spermatic cord, and extending slightly downward.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Am. be.]
Pain across sacrum with urgency to stool.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Am. be.]
Sensation of internal soreness on pressure in leaning back against cushioned back of carriage, in region of right kidney.
Bloated face, eyelids swollen, head heavy, stupid ; urine scanty, smoky. θ Albuminuria.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Am. be.]
Increased mucous secretion in larynx, causes frequent hawking and spitting.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Am. be.]
Increased frequency of pulse.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Am. be.]
Pain across sacrum with urgency to stool.
Soreness in region of right kidney when pressing back against seat of carriage.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Am. be.]
Right : swelling under tongue ; soreness in kidney.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Am. be.]
Soreness : and swelling in eyes ; in region of r. kidney ; between abdominal rings, in spermatic cord.
Increased warmth and discomfort in stomach.
Pain : across sacrum.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Am. be.]
Albuminuria.
Gout with fluid in great toe-joint or with lithates.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Am. be.]
Pressure : against seat of carriage ; soreness in kidney.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Am. be.]
Similar to its relatives, the ammonia salts and Benz. ac., especially the latter in gout, rheumatism and kidney affections, and the Amm. phosph., in gouty deposits.
Also similar to : Gnaphal. (gouty concretions) ; Caustic. ; Tereb., (smoky, albuminous urine ; rheumatism).
